# Contributors

Beau Barker ([@bcb](https://github.com/bcb)) created jsonrpcserver, starting with [Initial import](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/commit/bfe7301b610c8fb6fc783efdd2935dd02ef07a6a) in 2014. Synapse Research has maintained it since 6 October 2026.

Everyone else on GitHub's contributor list for jsonrpcserver is below, by GitHub login. Bots are left out. Each link goes to the person's first change on main, or to the pull request it came in. The link text is that change's own title.

- Ben Abulafia ([@bensynapse](https://github.com/bensynapse)): [Validate JSON-RPC batch members separately](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/291) (2026)
- Brahm Lower ([@brahmlower](https://github.com/brahmlower)): [Updated method of logging exceptions in Request.process](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/18) (2016)
- [@deptyped](https://github.com/deptyped): [Add ability to use custom serializer and deserializer](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/125) (2020)
- E. M. Bray ([@embray](https://github.com/embray)): [allow asyncio.CancelledError to bubble out of handle\_exceptions](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/132) (2020)
- JP ([@ferrouswheel](https://github.com/ferrouswheel)): [trim\_log\_values option for dispatcher](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/66) (2018)
- Alexander Shishenko ([@GamePad64](https://github.com/GamePad64)): [Update jsonschema version to 3.x](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/79) (2019)
- Daniel G. ([@gonvaled](https://github.com/gonvaled)): [Pass context even when no parameters available](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/76) (2019)
- Marcelo Duarte Trevisani ([@marcelotrevisani](https://github.com/marcelotrevisani)): [Packaging license](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/88) (2019)
- Mike Placentra ([@mikepii](https://github.com/mikepii)): [fix reversed Result monad](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/227) (2022)
- Nicola Lunghi ([@nicola-lunghi](https://github.com/nicola-lunghi)): [examples: add an example for mqtt](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/113) (2020)
- [@pawel-slowik](https://github.com/pawel-slowik): [Replace the funcsigs backport with inspect from the standard library](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/81) (2019)
- [@roadscape](https://github.com/roadscape): [allow request\_id to be falsy but not None, fix \#56](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/57) (2017)
- Ryan Wickwire ([@rwckr](https://github.com/rwckr)): [custom logger](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/240) (2022)
- Sam Van Den Berge ([@S4mw1s3](https://github.com/S4mw1s3)): [Use importlib.resources instead of pkg\_resources](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/235) (2022)
- Maximilian Stein ([@st31ny](https://github.com/st31ny)): [Add ApiError](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/commit/61868a227c12e08d243f0e72a9df2bef05cbb231) (2019)
- voice of texnoforge ([@voice-of-texnoforge](https://github.com/voice-of-texnoforge)): [Improve docs landing page visual structure](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/167) (2021)
- Janus Troelsen ([@ysangkok](https://github.com/ysangkok)): [Import ABC from collections.abc](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/pull/96) (2019)

Some commits came from email addresses that aren't linked to a GitHub account, so GitHub can't list their authors. Their work is in the [commit history](https://github.com/bensynapse/jsonrpcserver/commits/main/).

## How to contribute

Bug reports and pull requests are welcome. [Contributing](contributing.md) explains how to set up, run the checks and send a pull request.
